mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_code (phone, code, expire_time, used, create_time) VALUES (#{phone}, #{code}, #{expireTime}, #{used}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, phone, code, expire_time, used, create_time FROM sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_code SET used = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sms_code WHERE expire_time < NOW()
